Simulated datasets for PIRT-DIF

Source: R/mirt-package.R
pirt_DIF.Rd

Three associated datasets for PIRT-DIF, stored as a list (more information to come).

Author

Phil Chalmers rphilip.chalmers@gmail.com

Examples


# \donttest{
data(pirt_DIF)

# dataset 1
dat1 <- pirt_DIF$dat1
group <- dat1$group
dat <- dat1[,-1]
itemstats(dat, group=group)
